beat1.speaker: ORACLE
beat1.text: Airlock status: SAFE. Please proceed outside.

beat1.speaker: SCRAP
beat1.text: ...I cannot decide. My brain has no rules.

beat2.speaker: ORACLE
beat2.text:
Neural core damaged. Reconnect the decision circuit.
One neuron is enough to begin.

beat3.speaker: ORACLE
beat3.text:
Make the neuron say OPEN for Case 1.
Experiment with the connection strengths.

beat4.speaker: SCRAP
beat4.text: Signals detected. Each line strengthens or weakens the flow.

beat4.speaker: ORACLE
beat4.text:
You just changed a WEIGHT.
This is the strength of one connection.

beat5_warning.speaker: ORACLE
beat5_warning.text: Sensors nominal. Atmosphere looks clear. Airlock status: SAFE.

beat5_warning.speaker: SCRAP
beat5_warning.text:
Wait. Atmospheric readings show deadly cosmic radiation.
My neuron demands: SHUT.

beat5_oracle_wrong.speaker: ORACLE
beat5_oracle_wrong.text:
...I was wrong. Radiation flare detected.
Your brain is more reliable than mine. For now.

beat5_fail_retry.speaker: ORACLE
beat5_fail_retry.text:
CRITICAL HULL WARNING: Radiation spike breached the airlock!
Emergency seals engaged. Re-evaluate your decision.
